purpose: Independent behavioral confirmation of the complete V2-M1 through V2-M3 authorization chain on fresh data

amendment_record.reason: OnlineEntityGraph._probabilistic_assign hardcoded a 6-step window past which an unmatched track is excluded from reacquisition, calibrated for this class's native V2-M2/M3 worlds whose occlusions run about 2 of every 23 steps. The V2-I1 system-integration probe (docs/experiments/V2_I1_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md), which composes this mechanism with V2-M4's occlusion-heavy fixed-camera world, measured self-entity occlusion runs up to 10 consecutive steps and found identity could never survive them: a brand-new track was created every time, regardless of how accurately the old track's extrapolation tracked the true position. This amendment adds a `reacquisition_window` constructor parameter (default 6, matching the prior hardcoded value exactly) so callers with longer-occlusion environments can opt into a wider window without changing behavior for existing callers. Verified empirically, not just argued: development-split results for V2-M2 (results/V2-M2-probabilistic-development-summary.json), V2-M3 (results/V2-M3-body-graph-development-summary.json and its no-causal-likelihood ablation) were captured before this change and re-run after it with the new code's default parameter; every field is byte-for-byte identical except cpu_wall_seconds (a timing measurement, not a behavioral output). No existing caller (v2_m2.py, v2_m3_hypotheses.py, v2_m1_m3_confirmation.py) passes the new parameter, so none of their behavior changes. The already-published v2 confirmation result and its reported metrics remain the authoritative one-shot evidence for the historical M1-M3 chain; this amendment does not authorize or require a new confirmation run.

scope_statement.claim: Fresh-data behavioral confirmation of control discovery, probabilistic identity retention, and calibrated complete-body graph selection
not_claimed: Direct serialization or state handoff from the historical M1 implementation into M2
More than two complete body hypotheses
scope_statement.composition_fact: M2 relearns control relations and M3 extends the M2 entity graph; the historical M1 agent is a stage-specific mechanism check, not a serialized upstream state provider

decision_rule: Authorize design of unprivileged V2-M4 only if every fixed gate passes on the one-shot fresh confirmation. Development results cannot authorize progression, and confirmation failure cannot be repaired by changing this protocol or rerunning its confirmation seeds.
